Use when the user asks to run, automate, or update a daily fund report, or needs holdings-based status observation, market tracking, a visual HTML report, QQ email delivery, or data-availability safeguards based on multi-timeframe confirmation, RSI, volatility, liquidity, support anchors, concentration, overlap, drawdown, and profit management. The output is descriptive status only and contains no buy, sell, add, or reduce instructions.
skills.description_zh: 个人基金持仓的每日收盘前观察报告。按多周期确认、RSI、波动率、支撑锚点与集中度做持仓状态观察，输出可视化 HTML 报告并支持邮件送达。只做客观状态描述与提示，不给任何买卖指令；数据不可用时按契约降级为结构复核。
skills.name: 基金持仓观察日报 基金日报 持仓日报 基金复盘
